### Marion County

### CS/CS/SB 484 (2026)

- **Policy ID:** `fl-cs-cs-sb-484-2026`
- **Sponsor / party:** Sen. Bryan Avila; co-introducers Sen. Clay Yarborough and Sen. Don Gaetz; R
- **Status:** Approved by Governor 2026-05-07; Ch. 2026-65 assigned 2026-05-08; general effective date 2026-07-01, with exceptions; sections 1, 4 and 8 effective upon becoming law. Focal large-load tariff provision appears in official 2026 codification observed 2026-11-07; complete whole-act operative history remains unverified.
- **Provisions:** Preserves local comprehensive planning and land development authority for large load customers; says large load customers are not electric substations for local siting purposes; creates PSC large-load tariff requirements for 50 MW or larger customers; bars cost shifting to general ratepayers; allows curtailment for grid stability; creates large-scale data center water-permit requirements; requires hearings for certain consumptive use applications; authorizes reclaimed-water requirements; directs OPPAGA study.
- **Mechanism / scope:** utility_large_load_restriction; mixed
- **Legal effect:** in_force
- **Effective date:** 2026-07-01
- **End condition and limitations:** —
- **Primary reference:** [Official source](<https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2026/484>)
